pritch.definition:
n. A sharp-pointed instrument; also, an eelspear.
n. Pique; offense.
pritch.translation: abbr. Pritchard 普瑞特查德（姓氏）

pritchel.definition:
n. A tool employed by blacksmiths for punching or enlarging
   the nail holes in a horseshoe.

pritchetts.translation: (PRITCHETT 的复数) n. (Pritchett)人名；(英)普里切特

prithee.definition:
interj. A corruption of pray thee; as, I prithee; generally
   used without I.

prittle-prattle.definition:
n. Empty talk; trifling loquacity; prattle; -- used
   in contempt or ridicule.
prittle-prattle.translation:
n. 空谈
vi. 空谈
